title: Join between two RLS-protected tables (documents JOIN comments)
issue: Each side's policy is an opaque filter with default selectivity, so join order/method are chosen on guesses; row estimates multiply across the join.
symptom: naive_rls (EXISTS on both sides) joins with badly mis-estimated rows (est. tens of thousands vs hundreds actual) and picks a nested loop / re-filters with SubPlans; best_practice_rls (org_id denormalised + = ANY(array) on both) is much better.

scale.meaning: rows in app.documents and in app.comments (100 docs per org, scale/20 users; comments carry a denormalised org_id).
